capabilities: Show a local semantic graph of linked and candidate notes for the active note
Insert or remove links by clicking candidate and context nodes
Embed note metadata using Ollama Native or OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings providers
Tune ranking weights, graph display, link insert templates, and URL strategy
Optionally rank candidates using recorded local click and insert feedback
extras: Desktop-only due to local cache files and desktop APIs. Manual installation only (copy manifest.json, main.js, styles.css into the plugins folder). Feedback-aware ranking is disabled by default because of sample bias, and embedding requests send metadata text only, not full note bodies.
problem: Obsidian's graph only shows links that already exist, so finding unlinked but related notes and adding links by hand is slow and depends on the user remembering candidates.

relations.evidence: Semantic Linker pairs well with Front Matter Generator (GitHub), which is also maintained by Neurocoda.
Use Ollama Native embeddings, defaulting to and bge-m3.

requires.name: Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible embeddings provider
API key for OpenAI-compatible embeddings mode

summary: Graph-sidebar plugin that recommends semantically related notes from indexed front matter metadata and inserts curated links with a click.
